pages.title: Introduction
pages.content:
## Welcome to Relics

Relics are placeable props with a past: lanterns, gramophones, gift boxes, whole holiday sets. They are not blocks - you place them like furniture, right-click them to use them, and many have a mind of their own (they light, play, count down or react to the calendar).

### What you will do

* **Place a scene.** Props sit flush on the floor, wall or ceiling and keep the style of the room. The steampunk and Japanese collections fit the whole year; the seasonal sets bring a holiday to your street.
* **Use them.** If a relic does something, right-click does it. Sneak + right-click often opens a small menu (music props, countdown boards).
* **Follow the calendar.** Some relics only come alive in their season: the advent calendar opens one door a day from December 1, gift boxes only open in the gift window, the temple bell rings out the old year.

### How the pages are organised

**Xmas Town Props** covers the December collection (sleigh, tree, advent calendar, music box and all). **Gift Boxes & Advent** explains the two relics that follow the real calendar. Every relic description tells you what right-click does.

### Start here

1. Look at [Xmas Town Props](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props) for the December set.
2. Read [Gift Boxes & Advent](/wiki?page=relics-gifts) before December 24.

pages.title: Xmas Town Props
pages.content:
## The December collection

Seventeen props make Xmas Town, and you can own any of them for your own base. All are Relics: placeable, right-clickable, and they keep working after a restart.

* [Christmas Tree](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-christmas-tree) - Brass gears, glass baubles and a star that never dims (twinkles)
* [String Lights](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-string-lights) - Hangs on a wall or from a ceiling; full-block strands with fat bulbs
* [Advent Wreath](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-advent-wreath) - One more candle burns every Sunday of Advent
* [Brass Steam Lantern](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-brass-steam-lantern) - Warm light with a little puff of steam
* [Snow Lantern](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-snow-lantern) - A yukimi stone lantern, capped with snow
* [Giant Candy Cane](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-giant-candy-cane) - Two blocks of peppermint - right-click with a dye to repaint the stripes
* [Kadomatsu](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-kadomatsu) - Bamboo and pine to welcome the new year
* [Hearth](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-hearth) - Stockings on the mantle, a fire that keeps the snow outside
* [Snowman](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-snowman) - Top hat, brass goggles, carrot nose, gentle snowfall
* [Sleigh](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-sleigh) - Right-click to sit in it
* [Clockwork Toy Train](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-clockwork-toy-train) - Round and round it goes
* [Gift Box](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-gift-box) - Fill it, lock it for one player (see [Gift Boxes & Advent](/wiki?page=relics-gifts))
* [Advent Calendar](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-advent-calendar) - One door a day, December 1 to 24
* [Music Box](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-music-box) - Right-click plays the carol playlist; sneak + right-click for songs, shuffle and pause
* [Snow Globe](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-snow-globe) - Shake it with a right-click
* [Christmas Market Stall](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-christmas-market-stall) - Ginger, greens and gold for sale
* [Cookie Plate](/wiki?page=relics-xmas-props-cookie-plate) - Take a cookie with a right-click; refill it with gingerbread

### Good to know

* The **countdown board** on the village plaza and the **Countdown Clock** and **Temple Bell** are New Year relics - same idea, different season.
* Placed props keep their old look after a resource-pack update until the chunk reloads: break and replace is the quickest way to see a fresh version.

pages.title: Gift Boxes & Advent
pages.content:
## The relics that follow the calendar


* [Gift Box](/wiki?page=relics-gifts-gift-box)
* [Advent Calendar](/wiki?page=relics-gifts-advent-calendar)
* [Countdown board & Countdown Clock](/wiki?page=relics-gifts-countdown-board-countdown)
* [Secret Santa](/wiki?page=relics-gifts-secret-santa)
* [Good to know](/wiki?page=relics-gifts-good-to-know)

pages.title: Gift Box
pages.content:
Right-click fills it with presents (nine). Pick a wrapping colour, then **lock it for one player** by typing their name in chat - from that moment only they can open it, and only during the **gift window: December 24 to 26**. "cancel" puts the box back in your hand. You cannot open your own box, and a locked box cannot be broken by anyone but staff. Gift boxes are not craftable: they are handed out for events such as the Secret Santa.

Back to [Gift Boxes & Advent](/wiki?page=relics-gifts)

pages.title: Advent Calendar
pages.content:
The calendar has a door for **each day from December 1 to 25**, and each player can open each door exactly once. No skipping, no stacking.

Back to [Gift Boxes & Advent](/wiki?page=relics-gifts)

pages.title: Countdown board & Countdown Clock
pages.content:
The plaza countdown board counts down to Christmas; its placer can change the timezone (sneak + right-click cycles the ten zones). The New Year Countdown Clock does the same for midnight on the 31st and strikes twelve when it is time. Both also work as staff-placed village furniture.

Back to [Gift Boxes & Advent](/wiki?page=relics-gifts)

pages.title: Secret Santa
pages.content:
Not a prop but a staff command (`/relics secret`): named players draw lots, everyone gets a fresh box and a whisper of who to fill it for. Announced on Discord before each run - check the [news page](/news).

Back to [Gift Boxes & Advent](/wiki?page=relics-gifts)

pages.title: Good to know
pages.content:
* The gift window is also when Santa walks with presents (see the Xmas Town chapter).
* Filling and wrapping take one chest's worth of luck: contents come from the server's gift table, so nobody knows what is inside - not even the placer.

Back to [Gift Boxes & Advent](/wiki?page=relics-gifts)

pages.title: Wish Tree & Curios
pages.content:
## Evergreen curiosities

Not every relic waits for a holiday. The **Curio** collection lives in your builds all year. Two favourites:


* [Wish Tree (tanabata)](/wiki?page=relics-curios-wish-tree-tanabata)
* [Brass Telescope](/wiki?page=relics-curios-brass-telescope)
* [Good to know](/wiki?page=relics-curios-good-to-know)

pages.title: Wish Tree (tanabata)
pages.content:
Craft: cherry sapling + flower pot + paper. Place it, then **right-click with a sheet of paper and type your wish** - it hangs in the branches as a coloured strip, and everyone who passes can read the canopy. There is no fee and no rule about what you wish for. The tree grows into a proper cherry tree two blocks high with bamboo beside it, and since November the wishes hang in the fringe of the crown instead of a sad little seedling.

Back to [Wish Tree & Curios](/wiki?page=relics-curios)

pages.title: Brass Telescope
pages.content:
Craft: spyglass + two gold ingots. Place it and **right-click to look through it**. Since November it is a proper full-height brass instrument on a wide tripod with stacked tube segments - and whether the lens shows you across the map is a staff secret.

Back to [Wish Tree & Curios](/wiki?page=relics-curios)

pages.title: Good to know
pages.content:
* Curios are purely decoration unless right-click does something - try right-click first, then sneak + right-click.
* Everything craftable shows up in `/zukan`; the rest is event, shop or quest reward.

Back to [Wish Tree & Curios](/wiki?page=relics-curios)
